mapper.select: SELECT id FROM user_account WHERE id=#{userId} AND is_deleted=0 AND account_status=1 AND wallet_activated_at IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM wallet_recharge_order WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND client_request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT * FROM wallet_recharge_order WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND order_no=#{orderNo}
SELECT * FROM wallet_recharge_order WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_recharge_order SET qr_code=#{qr} WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='PENDING' AND qr_code IS NULL

UPDATE wallet_recharge_order SET last_query_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='PENDING' AND (last_query_at IS NULL OR last_query_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-5,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)))

UPDATE wallet_recharge_order SET status='PAID',provider_trade_no=#{tradeNo},paid_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),credited_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE wallet_recharge_order SET status='CLOSED',closed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_sandbox_account(user_id) VALUES(#{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=user_id
mapper.select: SELECT balance_cents FROM wallet_sandbox_account WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
